title.bn: C99 থেকে C23: সংস্করণ বুঝে ফিচার বাছা

summary.en: Select a language mode, recognise the main C99, C11, C17 and C23 changes, and separate standard features from compiler support.
summary.bn: ভাষার mode বেছে C99, C11, C17 ও C23-এর পরিবর্তন বোঝো এবং compiler support আলাদা করে যাচাই করো।

notes: The C23 examples use GCC 14.2 -std=c2x; #embed is explained but not claimed to be supported by this compiler.

sections.title: Pick the language your tools actually speak
Select a standard and keep extensions visible
Follow the main changes through the revisions
Compile representative features in their intended modes
Do not confuse acceptance, support and safety
Document the baseline and the exceptions

examples.title: Use C99 loop declarations and designated initialisers
examples.explanationHtml: C99 permits declaring i in the for initialiser and assigning structure members by name. Designated initialisers reduce dependence on member order. Compile this example in C99 mode rather than assuming an old default compiler mode.

examples.title: Use a C11 assertion and an anonymous nested structure
examples.explanationHtml: The assertion checks a compile-time condition. The unnamed nested structure exposes x and y through point directly; it does not allocate a second dynamic object. C11 also removed gets from the standard library.

examples.title: Try supported C23 spelling without changing the C17 baseline
examples.explanationHtml: GCC 14.2 accepts these C23 features in -std=c2x mode: keyword bool/true/false, nullptr, typeof, binary literals and digit separators. This does not imply that the same compiler implements every C23 facility, especially #embed.

examples.title: Reject the removed unbounded gets interface
examples.explanationHtml: This intentionally invalid C17 program uses gets, which was removed in C11. It has no buffer-size argument and cannot be made safe by choosing a larger array. The strict compiler rejects its missing declaration; use bounded fgets and define an overlong-line policy.

practice.title: Use designated initialisers for a mark record
practice.statementHtml: Read roll from 1 through 999 and score from 0 through 100, with input tokens representable as int. Initialise a Mark structure by named members, then print roll and score. Invalid or missing input prints invalid. The program remains C17 compatible.
hints: Validate before constructing the accepted result.
Member names make the intended assignment visible.

practice.title: Express a Boolean predicate in portable C17
practice.statementHtml: Read a mark from 0 through 100. Use bool from stdbool.h and print pass or fail for the threshold 40. Missing or invalid input prints invalid. Keep the source valid before C23 keyword bool.
hints: C17 needs the header for the familiar bool spelling.
The comparison already produces a truth value.

practice.title: Plan a feature-support check for #embed
practice.statementHtml: Your compiler accepts -std=c2x but rejects #embed. Explain why those facts are compatible and propose an honest fallback.
hints: Language mode and complete implementation are different.
practice.answerHtml: A compiler may implement only part of a standard while accepting its mode switch. Consult its version-specific feature status. Keep a small isolated feature test and use a newer supporting compiler when required. For a portable fallback, generate a reviewed byte-array initializer or load a file at runtime, explicitly noting the different build/runtime behavior. Do not label an uncompiled directive as a verified executable example.

practice.title: Review a proposed old-compiler compatibility claim
practice.statementHtml: A source uses for-loop declarations, _Static_assert and nullptr. Which minimum versions matter, and how should the project choose its baseline?
hints: Identify the newest required feature rather than the file extension.
practice.answerHtml: The loop declaration is available from C99, _Static_assert from C11, and nullptr from C23. The complete source therefore needs a supporting C23 implementation unless those parts are rewritten or conditionally excluded. Choose and document the intended baseline, compile with that explicit mode and test it. A .c extension or a permissive default mode does not prove C99 compatibility.

quiz.prompt: Which standard introduced declarations in a for initialiser?
quiz.explanation: The declaration has loop scope under C99 and later.
Its unbounded input contract made it unsuitable for safe use.

quiz.prompt: What does C17 mainly provide relative to C11?
options: Corrections and clarifications rather than a large feature set
quiz.explanation: C17 is often a practical stable baseline.
It cannot replace a runtime validation branch.

quiz.prompt: Does accepting -std=c2x prove support for every C23 feature?
quiz.explanation: Support depends on the compiler version and individual feature.

quiz.prompt: What does a digit separator in 1'000 change?
options: Source readability, not the numeric value
quiz.explanation: The separator is part of supported literal syntax.

quiz.prompt: Which facility embeds resource bytes during translation in supporting C23 implementations?
quiz.explanation: It differs from reading a runtime file and needs actual compiler support.

quiz.prompt: Which designated member values are printed in this C99-compatible record?
quiz.explanation: Named initialisers assign by member name, not by their written order.

quiz.prompt: What does the C17 Boolean comparison print?
quiz.explanation: The comparison is true and bool stores one.

quiz.prompt: Which decimal value does the supported C23 binary literal denote?
quiz.explanation: The set bits represent eight plus two.

keyPoints.en: Choose a standard mode explicitly instead of relying on a compiler default.
keyPoints.bn: Compiler-এর default ধরে না নিয়ে ভাষার standard mode স্পষ্ট করে বেছে নাও।

keyPoints.en: C99 added practical initialisation and declaration features.
keyPoints.bn: C99-এ declaration ও initialisation-এর দরকারি নতুন সুবিধা এসেছে।

keyPoints.en: C11 added compile-time assertions and removed gets.
keyPoints.bn: C11-এ compile-time assertion এসেছে এবং gets বাদ গেছে।

keyPoints.en: C17 focuses on corrections to the C11 language and library.
keyPoints.bn: C17 মূলত C11-এর ভাষা ও লাইব্রেরির সংশোধন একত্র করে।

keyPoints.en: C23 features require version-specific compiler support checks.
keyPoints.bn: C23-এর ফিচার ব্যবহার করার আগে নির্দিষ্ট compiler version-এর support যাচাই করো।

keyPoints.en: A supported language mode is not a complete feature checklist.
keyPoints.bn: একটি mode চালু হলেই তার সব ফিচার কাজ করবে ধরে নিও না।

examQuestions.question: Compare one important change in each of C99, C11, C17 and C23.
examQuestions.answerHtml: C99 added features such as designated initialisers and declarations in for initialisers. C11 added _Static_assert and anonymous structures and removed gets. C17 collected corrections and clarifications. C23 added facilities including keyword bool, nullptr, typeof and newer literal syntax. State compiler support separately from the standard that specifies the feature.

examQuestions.question: Why is replacing gets with scanf("%s") not a complete safe migration?
examQuestions.answerHtml: An unbounded %s can still overflow its destination, and token input does not preserve spaces in a line. Use an appropriate width for bounded token input or fgets for lines, then check the read result and handle overlong input deliberately. A newer standard mode does not supply a missing input-size policy.

examQuestions.question: Explain #embed and the limit of the compiler used here.
examQuestions.answerHtml: In supporting C23 implementations, #embed incorporates resource data during translation, commonly to initialise a byte array. It is not runtime file loading. GCC 14.2 accepts the demonstrated C23 spellings but does not implement this directive, so no runnable #embed example is claimed here. A later supporting compiler or an explicit fallback is required.
